verdict.rationale: Docs confirm sharing via public link (viewable by anyone with a Google account) and Workspace core-service integration, plus export of notes to Google Docs/Sheets and slide decks as PDFs for collaboration; paid users get analytics on public notebook usage. However, evidence lacks detail on granular collaborator permissions (edit/comment roles), real-time co-editing, or team workspace sharing beyond public link/Workspace context. missing for 10: role-based collaborator permissions, real-time multi-user editing/co-building evidence, independent corroboration of sharing experience.
